title: L7 probe: the Hebrew frame lines and word clips of the re-cut language courses (docs/voice/l7-voice-plan.md section 2). 14 short clips, said before the three course runs, so that a changed carrier text is found before the counts are typed.
note: Voice director, 2026-11-15. Texts are the voice texts of content/languages/<course>/voice-plan.json as the course run will send them (the first clip of each group), plus the carrier variants. Nitzi says every Hebrew clip; the male Russian puppet voice says the last one. Settings are the course settings (v4, stability 0.5, similarity 0.75). No clip has a ! . The listener marks each clip heard-ok or heard-wrong; see the tests column.
